operating_contract.objective: Record the origin, version, license and supplier of every third-party model, dataset and AI component in an AI bill of materials, monitor the pre-trained models in use, and keep contingency plans for failures in high-risk third-party AI.
operating_contract.evidence_requirement: Attested evidence: a current AI bill of materials (CycloneDX or SPDX, importable through the AIBOM store) lists each pre-trained model, dataset and AI service with source, version, license, supplier and responsible party. `kubernetes-cluster` image provenance covers the serving container images, not model weights. A production model missing from the AI-BOM, or a high-risk third-party AI dependency without a contingency plan, is an open violation.
